qa_pairs.question: How can a user determine the memory requirements for a VASP job?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can get an initial memory estimate by preparing all their input files and then running `makeparam` in an interactive job submission. For a more accurate estimate for future jobs, it is recommended to check the maximum stack size used by completed jobs and use that value as the memory requirement per processor for the next job.

qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure for installing a custom version of VASP on the clusters using your own source code?
qa_pairs.answer: If you are licensed to use VASP and have access to its source code, you can install various versions in your `/home` directory on all clusters using `EasyBuild` commands. You'll need to run `eb -f [RECIPE NAME] --sourcepath=[SOURCEPATH]`, where `[SOURCEPATH]` is the directory containing your VASP source code (downloaded from the VASP website) and `[RECIPE NAME]` is the specific recipe name from the available options. This process can take over an hour, after which you can load and run VASP using `module` commands.
